conditionDescriptions.ablaze: On fire. Minor: Takes 1d5 Damage (ignoring AP) at the start of each Turn; resist with an Athletics test. Major: Takes 1d10 Damage (ignoring AP) at the start of each Turn.
conditionDescriptions.bleeding: Losing blood. Minor: Takes 1 Damage (ignoring AP) at the end of each Turn. Major: Takes 3 Damage (ignoring AP) at the end of each Turn.
conditionDescriptions.blinded: Cannot see. Tests relying on sight only succeed on a roll of 01–05. Disadvantage on Melee and Reflexes (Dodge) Tests.
conditionDescriptions.deafened: Cannot hear. Disadvantage on Tests relying on hearing.
conditionDescriptions.fatigued: Exhausted. Minor: Disadvantage on all Tests. Major: All Tests are Very Hard (−30).
conditionDescriptions.frightened: Terrified. Minor: Disadvantage to confront the source of Fear; Advantage on Awareness and Intuition Tests. Major: Cannot approach the source of Fear.
conditionDescriptions.incapacitated: Severely impaired. All Damage taken results in Critical Hits.
conditionDescriptions.overburdened: Carrying too much. Speed reduced by 1. Disadvantage on Agility Tests.
conditionDescriptions.poisoned: Affected by toxin. Minor: Disadvantage on Strength and Toughness Tests; max SL on all Tests equals Toughness Bonus. Major: Immediately becomes Prone and Incapacitated.
conditionDescriptions.prone: Lying on the ground. Disadvantage on Melee Tests. Attackers within Immediate range gain Advantage; attackers from outside Immediate range suffer Disadvantage.
conditionDescriptions.restrained: Held in place. Minor: Disadvantage on Athletics, Dexterity, Melee, Reflexes, and Ranged Tests. Major: Immediately becomes Incapacitated.
conditionDescriptions.stunned: Dazed. Minor: Loses next Action. Major: Disadvantage on all Tests.
conditionDescriptions.unconscious: Knocked out. Immediately becomes Prone and Incapacitated.

actions.rest6hMessage: Rested for 6 hours and healed {wounds} Wound(s).
actions.restDayMessage: Rested for an entire day and healed {wounds} Wound(s).

warnings.noCrewForTest: No crew or passengers — assign actors to the vehicle before rolling.
